registered effect consumption: BASILISK28 and PETRIFY34 are separate registered ElixirPetrify instances sharing class/NBT keys and movement modifier UUID. Reflection registerPotion makes ElixirPotionEffect, actual Forge potion event registers it, isReady/performEffect native overrides delegate. createEffect resolves registry string; isActive scans active potion collection and compares registry-name reference == to stored potionID without its own duration test. Attribute base-1 operation2 is multiplied by strength+1 in wrapper; no final movement speed or clamping claim.

continuity-qualified pose capture: ElixirPetrify.performEffect compares stored ticks with current ticksExisted-1; mismatch captures current yaw/head/pitch, then every invocation stores current tick and calls setLocationAndAngles at CURRENT XYZ with saved yaw/pitch and sets head yaw. Consecutive once-per-tick calls reuse pose; a gap causes recapture. Same-tick repeated invocation also mismatches after first stored current tick; recaptures current fields, not necessarily different values. No explicit initialized flag, duration check, server-only gate, NoAI toggle, original-position storage or cleanup/restore hook.

actual motion consumers: Registered common handler LivingUpdate zeros XZ when either status isActive; ROOT_BOUND separately sets web and shares jump path (014 owner). No petrify check in shown attack/arm/use handlers; this is not blanket server action cancellation, external setPos immunity or Y freeze.

actual local view consumer: Mod init→proxy.registerEventHandlers→ClientProxy binds ElixirClientHandler.INSTANCE. FogColors uses current local Minecraft player, checks either status and rewrites BOTH current and previous pitch/yaw/headYaw from same local NBT. Does not verify captured-tick freshness/key initialization or that event view entity is local player. There is no dedicated pose synchronization/ACK in these paths; native status sync and ordering relative to mouse/network/other listeners not expanded.
